plan.summary:
This PR exports the retry policy from both public entry points, so library users can build their own policy.

- `src/index.ts` now re-exports `RetryPolicy` and the `RetryOptions` type from `./retry`.
- `crates/core/src/lib.rs` now re-exports `RetryPolicy` at the crate root. The `retry` module was already declared `pub`.
plan.riskRationale: Two one-line re-exports add public API surface. No logic changes. The exports can only expose existing code.
plan.storyArc: The change has one purpose: make the retry policy part of the public API. The TypeScript and Rust entry points each get one re-export.

topics.title: Export RetryPolicy from the TypeScript and Rust entry points
topics.narrativeBrief: What new public API do library users get from the TypeScript and Rust entry points? Verify that `./retry` exports `RetryPolicy` and `RetryOptions`, and that the Rust `retry` module defines `RetryPolicy`.
